<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for all review comments with AI agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed.

Inline comments:
In `@libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/components/clusterWizard/ClusterDetails.tsx`:
- Around line 113-118: The code currently passes params.pullSecret into
navigate(...) state (see navigate call in ClusterDetails.tsx using
ClusterWizardFlowStateNew and params.pullSecret); remove the pullSecret from the
navigation state and instead store the secret in an in-memory, ephemeral store
or React context keyed by cluster id (e.g., a PullSecretContext or
PullSecretStore.set(cluster.id, params.pullSecret)) before calling navigate, and
read it from that context in downstream wizard components; ensure the store is
cleared on cluster changes/unmount (e.g., PullSecretStore.clear(cluster.id)) so
the secret does not persist in browser history or across wizards.

In
`@libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/components/clusterWizard/ClusterWizardContextProvider.tsx`:
- Around line 96-101: The effect using React.useEffect with
getClusterWizardPullSecretFromNavigateState currently only sets pull secret when
one is found, leaving a previous value when cluster?.id or location.state
changes; update the effect in ClusterWizardContextProvider so that it calls
setPullSecret(null or empty string) when
getClusterWizardPullSecretFromNavigateState returns no value (i.e., explicitly
clear contextPullSecret) so that ClusterDetails (which checks pullSecretSet and
prefers contextPullSecret) cannot reuse a stale secret—use the same symbols
(React.useEffect, getClusterWizardPullSecretFromNavigateState, setPullSecret,
cluster?.id, location.state) to locate and change the logic.
```

</details>
